note: Canonical partner identities for the AP map. Each entry: a canonical display name plus the variants that should resolve to it (matched against PMC name and/or DP name on the property record). Variants are case-insensitive substrings (the variant is matched whole, lowercase). When a property's PMC or DP matches any variant, the property's `partner_canonical` is set to the canonical name. Search + aggregation in the UI groups by `partner_canonical`, so typo'd or split-named partners merge under one identity. Re-run scripts/list-partner-mismatches.js to surface new candidates.
